product_metadata.title: linoroso Stackable Bento Box Adult Lunch Box | Meet All You On-the-Go Needs for Food, Salad and Snack Box, Premium Bento Lunch Box for Adults Include Utensil Set, Dressing Containers - Classic Blue
features: ✔[Convinent, Fun and Stylish] More than a bento lunch box for adult, they are inspired by the "balaned diet" mindset, designed with sleek, modernistic lines. This bento box come with a multitude of colors, no mater your taste you can find one that suits your sense of style.

✔[Compact and Easy Storage] This bento boxes are leak-proof and dishwasher, freezer and microwave safe. The top container features 3 compartments. It's sepecially designed to keep the food seperate. Whether it's fruits, vegetables, proteins etc, you can easily contain different kind of foods in certain quantities and proportions.

✔[BPA-Free] To avoid the need for single-use plastic bags and wrap, the reusable bento box, like ours, is super durable, safe and last for years. Made with food-grade, eco-friendly materials that complies with European & U.S. food contact grade standards.

✔[Versatile] Apart from packing a full meal with four perfect portion containers, the lunch-box easily transforms to one container bentobox for small lunch/a health snack while you want to keep food portion under control. (Only when using the top container, pls put its clips up and then the top cap clips down to snap together)

✔[What You Get] Top container with three compartments and bottom container. Bento box accessories : two sauce cups / salad dressing containers, utensils (creative designed fork and spoon) are all included. Plus - Caring customer support and flexible return policy.
